links.outcome: Reproducibility of ChatGPT answers to ACS guideline questions across repeated runs 30 days apart
links.effect: Binary accuracy 84% vs 86% (p=0.564), Kappa 0.94; multiple-choice 80% vs 84% (p=0.527), Kappa 0.93. Stable performance with minor fluctuations.
links.quote: These results suggest stable AI performance with minor fluctuations.

links.outcome: ChatGPT clinical knowledge accuracy against 2023 ESC ACS guidelines
links.effect: Binary accuracy 84% initially and 86% at 30 days; multiple-choice 80% initially and 84% at 30 days. Errors and hallucinations remain a concern.
links.quote: For binary questions, accuracy was 84% initially and 86% after 30 days, with no significant change (p = 0.564).

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's baseline accuracy and temporal consistency on a set of 100 clinical guideline questions without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
